ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent surge in Medicaid fraud cases, including the Feeding Our Future scandal and the Minnesota Medicaid fraud scheme.
questions: What are the root causes of Medicaid fraud?
How can we prevent future cases of Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: By examining the recent cases of Medicaid fraud, we can identify patterns and connections between entities, potentially leading to a larger expose on the issue.
